sermon.title: Vineyard—September 26, 2021
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A younger speaker teaches from Isaiah 5 that God planted His vineyard with the choicest vine, Jesus, and expects good fruit. Abide in the vine as Zacchaeus and the Emmaus disciples did, and don’t be upset with pruning: God pruned Joseph and Mary to bring more fruit.

faqs.question: Are there notes to follow along?
faqs.answer: Yes, papers up front to fill out.

faqs.question: Will God be rough with us?
faqs.answer: He might kick you a little on the way; that’s love.

faqs.question: Do I need a special calling ceremony?
faqs.answer: No; God calls you with the Scriptures.

faqs.question: Is there a better vine than Jesus?
faqs.answer: You cannot find a better vine anywhere.

faqs.question: Did Jesus have a slumber party with Zacchaeus?
What happens after you talk with Him?
faqs.answer: You stop asking those dumb questions and ask how to get more of Him.

faqs.question: What illustration does he use?
faqs.answer: Things he lost that he wants to find again.

faqs.question: Did Joseph waste away in prison?
faqs.answer: No; he worked for the prison keeper.
